plugins.name: project-skills-bootstrap
plugins.description: Installs a set of shared working conventions into the project. Together they govern how a change is written, reviewed, documented, and delivered, where its working files live, and how idiomatic its Korean prose reads. Each convention is a separate bootstrap skill, so a project can adopt only the ones it needs. The skill files are written under .agents/skills/ and symlinked from .claude/skills/, so the repository carries them.
